regions.region: page 1 title, abstract, and introduction opening
regions.finding: Present-paper iodohydroxylation is introduced, but this region contains no row-level experimental procedure or reaction arrow.
Six cited prior-work reaction examples are described and were classified as literature_example records rather than present-paper experiments.

regions.region: page 1 right-column discussion of Scheme 1 and Scheme 2
regions.finding: The authors discuss two generic prior-work stereochemical pathways and one proposed furanone-controlled mechanism; these were classified as mechanism records.

regions.region: page 1 bottom-right paragraph continuing onto page 2
regions.finding: The open-air 1a/I2 experiment begins here and continues on page 2; it is linked to Table 1 entry 1 rather than duplicated.

unresolved: The cited prior publications were not supplied and their omitted procedure details cannot be recovered from this page.
The main text states that supporting information is available online, but no SI file was supplied or explicitly associated.

regions.finding: Two generic pathways summarize earlier sulfoxide and sulfide/selenide halohydroxylation mechanisms; they are not present-paper row experiments.
Proposed favored and disfavored iodohydroxylation pathways are shown with generic R groups and were recorded as one mechanism, not as isolated experiments.
Narrative results map to Table 1 entries and were merged with the corresponding row records. The prose value of 51% for open-air Z-2a conflicts with the Table 1 value of 54% and both are retained.
The prose summarizes Table 2 scope, highlights the 51 h/62% 1f experiment, and states that Z-2k was supported by NOE and X-ray studies; row data are not duplicated here.

unresolved: Scheme intermediates and generic R-group structures are not fully specified and therefore have no complete verified SMILES.
The prose/Table 1 yield conflict for the open-air experiment remains unresolved.

regions.region: page 3 upper Table 1 reaction drawing, nine rows, and footnotes
regions.finding: All nine optimization conditions were extracted row-by-row. Entry 7 is represented by the merged record shared with Table 2 entry 1 and the typical procedure. Open-air footnote b applies only to entry 1; table dashes for Z-7a are preserved without interpreting them as zero.

regions.region: page 3 middle Table 2 generic arrow, twelve rows, and footnotes
regions.finding: All twelve substrate-scope rows were extracted. The generic arrow supplies common row context and was not counted as an extra experiment. Footnote b changes only entry 6 to 3.0 equivalents of I2.
The exact charge quantities, argon atmosphere, room temperature, and 1 h reaction time for 1a are the start of the same experiment as Table 1 entry 7/Table 2 entry 1 and were merged into that record.

unresolved: Table 2 does not explicitly state the yield measurement basis.
Workup and purification are absent for all scope rows except the merged 1a/Z-2a typical procedure.
Complex substrate/product structures and product stereochemical SMILES remain machine-unverified.

regions.finding: The figure is structural evidence for Z-2k, not a reaction experiment; it was linked to Table 2 entry 11.

regions.region: page 4 left-column completion of the typical procedure
regions.finding: Quench, extraction, washing, drying, evaporation, flash chromatography, isolated mass/yield, physical form, and characterization for Z-2a were merged into the Table 1 entry 7/Table 2 entry 1 record.

regions.region: page 4 acknowledgements, references, and crystallographic note
regions.finding: No additional present-paper reaction experiment appears here. The note supplies crystal data/CCDC 642223 for Z-2k; citations are not mined as new experiments.

unresolved: The Z-2k X-ray assignment supports identity but does not by itself make the machine-generated SMILES source-verified.
The online supplementary crystallographic data and other SI were not supplied or explicitly associated.
